ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- "INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, insight_frequency, preferred_wearable_metrics, preferred_nutrition_metrics, typical_breakfast_time, typical_lunch_time, typical_dinner_time, typical_sleep_time, target_sleep_duration_hrs, units_system, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:userId, COALESCE(:insightFrequency::insight_frequency_enum, 'daily'), COALESCE(string_to_array(:preferredWearableMetrics, ',')::wearable_metric_enum[], '{}'), COALESCE(string_to_array(:preferredNutritionMetrics, ',')::nutrition_metric_enum[], '{}'), :typicalBreakfastTime::time, :typicalLunchTime::time, :typicalDinnerTime::time, :typicalSleepTime::time, :targetSleepDurationHrs, COALESCE(:unitsSystem::units_system_enum, 'metric'), now(), now()) "

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { userId: vars.userId, insightFrequency: vars.preference.insightFrequency default null, preferredWearableMetrics: if ( vars.preference.preferredWearableMetrics != null and sizeOf(vars.preference.preferredWearableMetrics) > 0 ) (vars.preference.preferredWearableMetrics joinBy ",") else null, preferredNutritionMetrics: if ( vars.preference.preferredNutritionMetrics != null and sizeOf(vars.preference.preferredNutritionMetrics) > 0 ) (vars.preference.preferredNutritionMetrics joinBy ",") else null, typicalBreakfastTime: vars.preference.typicalBreakfastTime default null, typicalLunchTime: vars.preference.typicalLunchTime default null, typicalDinnerTime: vars.preference.typicalDinnerTime default null, typicalSleepTime: vars.preference.typicalSleepTime default null, targetSleepDurationHrs: vars.preference.targetSleepDurationHrs default null, unitsSystem: vars.preference.unitsSystem default null }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var setInsightFrequency = if ( vars.preference.insightFrequency != null ) "insight_frequency = :insightFrequency::insight_frequency_enum" else "" var setWearableMetrics = if ( vars.preference.preferredWearableMetrics != null ) "preferred_wearable_metrics = string_to_array(:preferredWearableMetrics, ',')::wearable_metric_enum[]" else "" var setNutritionMetrics = if ( vars.preference.preferredNutritionMetrics != null ) "preferred_nutrition_metrics = string_to_array(:preferredNutritionMetrics, ',')::nutrition_metric_enum[]" else "" var setBreakfastTime = if ( vars.preference.typicalBreakfastTime != null ) "typical_breakfast_time = :typicalBreakfastTime::time" else "" var setLunchTime = if ( vars.preference.typicalLunchTime != null ) "typical_lunch_time = :typicalLunchTime::time" else "" var setDinnerTime = if ( vars.preference.typicalDinnerTime != null ) "typical_dinner_time = :typicalDinnerTime::time" else "" var setSleepTime = if ( vars.preference.typicalSleepTime != null ) "typical_sleep_time = :typicalSleepTime::time" else "" var setTargetSleep = if ( vars.preference.targetSleepDurationHrs != null ) "target_sleep_duration_hrs = :targetSleepDurationHrs" else "" var setUnitsSystem = if ( vars.preference.unitsSystem != null ) "units_system = :unitsSystem::units_system_enum" else "" var updateClauses = [setInsightFrequency, setWearableMetrics, setNutritionMetrics, setBreakfastTime, setLunchTime, setDinnerTime, setSleepTime,setTargetSleep, setUnitsSystem] filter ($ != "") joinBy ", " --- "UPDATE user_preferences SET " ++ updateClauses ++ ", updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = :userId"

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { userId: vars.userId, insightFrequency: vars.preference.insightFrequency default null, preferredWearableMetrics: if ( vars.preference.preferredWearableMetrics != null and sizeOf(vars.preference.preferredWearableMetrics) > 0 ) (vars.preference.preferredWearableMetrics joinBy ",") else null, preferredNutritionMetrics: if ( vars.preference.preferredNutritionMetrics != null and sizeOf(vars.preference.preferredNutritionMetrics) > 0 ) (vars.preference.preferredNutritionMetrics joinBy ",") else null, typicalBreakfastTime: vars.preference.typicalBreakfastTime default null, typicalLunchTime: vars.preference.typicalLunchTime default null, typicalDinnerTime: vars.preference.typicalDinnerTime default null, typicalSleepTime: vars.preference.typicalSleepTime default null, targetSleepDurationHrs: vars.preference.targetSleepDurationHrs default null, unitsSystem: vars.preference.unitsSystem default null }
